confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for a well-known Riviera Maya resort town; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Beer, coffee, and meal anchors are moderately confident. Accommodation anchors are less certain, especially the 3-star and hostel figures for July peak season. Cocktail (about 2x beer) and wine (about 2.2x beer) are inferred from typical tourist-bar price ratios, not direct knowledge. Accommodation includes Mexican IVA and the Quintana Roo lodging tax. The FX observation comes from search-result summaries of RBA pages that I did not open directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Riviera Maya tourist-zone pricing, loosely benchmarked to Cancún and Tulum, adjusted for Playa del Carmen's mix of beach, Fifth Avenue, and budget-hostel areas during July high season.
